name: Incentive For The Simple Marriage
benefit: Financial Incentives: The scheme provides a financial incentive of Rs. 50,000.00 to eligible Simple Married Couples belonging to the SC community. Promotes Simple Marriages: The scheme aims to promote the concept of simple marriages, which can help reduce the financial burden on families and promote equality in society.
eligibility_rules: The eligibility criteria for the scheme are straightforward, making it easier for eligible couples to apply for and receive the incentive. Encourages Timely Application:

The incentive is provided only to those who have submitted applications within 1 year of their marriage, which encourages timely application and provides immediate financial assistance. Documentation Support: The scheme provides a clear list of required documents for application, which helps simplify the

Non-SC Community: The scheme is only applicable to Simple Married Couples belonging to the SC community. Couples belonging to other communities are not eligible for the incentive. Income Criteria: The scheme is applicable only to couples whose family income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2 lakhs per annum. Couples with higher incomes are not eligible for the scheme. Time Limit: The scheme is applicable only within 1 year of the marriage. Couples who apply after this time limit are not eligible for the incentive. Incomplete Documentation: Couples who fail to provide all the required documents for the application are not eligible for the incentive. Marriage Date: Only couples who got married on or after 11-08-2015 are eligible for the incentive. Couples who got married before this date are not eligible for the scheme. Application ProcessOnlineStep 1: Visit the official website of the Social Welfare Department of Karnataka.Step 2: Click on the "Incentive for Simple Marriage" link on the homepage.Step 3: Read the eligibility criteria and guidelines carefully before applying.Step 4: Click on the "Apply Online" button to proceed with the application.Step 5: Fill out the application form with all the necessary details such as personal information, income details, and marriage details.Step 6: Upload the required documents such as Aadhaar Card, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Bank Passbook, Marriage Registration Certificate, Marriage Photo, and mobile number.Step 7: Review the application form and ensure that all the information provided is accurate.Step 8: Click on the "Submit" button to complete the application process.Step 9: After submission, an SMS will be sent to the couple, and they can print the acknowledgement form as proof of application.Step 10: Social Welfare will do document verification to verify the details provided by the couple and process the application further.Step 11: After the application is approved, the incentive will be credited to the joint bank account of the couple.
